notes.title: Updates to Screen Resolution
notes.content:
Dear Players,

To Leave has been updated with a custom-screen to tweak the screen resolution. A letterbox has been added for those players with a 21:9 screen.


Sincerely yours,

Freaky Creations

notes.title: Preface
notes.content:
Dear Guest,

[b]To Leave is more than a game.[/b]

Every element in To Leave—from beginning to end—has been crafted to
challenge your skills, wits, perception, and intuition. Most importantly,
To Leave provides questions—not answers. Although much will be
indecipherable to you from the beginning, [i]rest assured that everything
in this game is deliberate ... and relevant.[/i] 


Devote your full attention to what you’re about to experience. 

[b]You won't regret it.[/b]

Yours truly,
Freaky Creations

[b]WARNING:[/b] To Leave deals with existential themes—including
suicide, depression, and social alienation. If you're in trouble,
this game alone won't help you. If you think you need it, 
ask for help. Do it now.
